what: a modelled S20x4 buttress thread on a d20 shaft down to a d30 shoulder, the steep flank toward the thread's end (up, the default): the 3 deg wall faces the shoulder
method: DIN 513-1 S20x4: 3 deg load flank, 30 deg clearance flank, flats (P - 0.75 P (tan3 + tan30))/2 = 0.26384 P, external minor d3 = d - 2 x 0.86777 P = 13.058. steep_flank end puts the 3 deg wall on the groove's side toward the shoulder (z = 10); the groove runs on past the shoulder's plane and is trimmed there, and runs out a pitch past the free top end, so every slice of the shaft along the axis loses the same. V = pi 15^2 10 + pi 10^2 30 - (30/P) V_turn, V_turn = 2 pi int_(d3/2)^(d/2) r w(r) dr = 347.540474, w(r) = P - 0.26384 P - (d/2 - r)(tan3 + tan30) the groove's width. 025 and 026 are the same volume, the flanks swapped
